name: Statistic
summary: A number that matters, with what it counts, its unit, its change since the last period and an optional trend line: the figures at the top of a dashboard or a report. Put several in a Grid, or one in a Card for a tile. Not for a table of numbers (use DataTable) or a share of a whole (use StackedBar).
a11y: The label comes first in reading order, then the figure, so it reads "Active users, 12,480". The change says its direction in words ("Up", "Down", "No change") through the icon's name, so colour is never the only cue; colour shows whether that's good news only when `good` says which way is. The trend line is hidden from screen readers: it illustrates the change, which is already said. A number is written in the reader's locale. A loading statistic is `aria-busy` and keeps its label.

props.name: label
props.description: What the number counts, in a few words: "Active users", "Revenue".

props.name: value
props.description: The figure. A number is written in the reader's locale with `format`; a string is shown exactly as written ("2×", "4.6").

props.name: format
props.description: How a number is written: `Intl.NumberFormat` options such as `{ notation: 'compact' }` or `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }`.

props.name: unit
props.description: A unit after the figure, set smaller: "ms", "km", "%".

props.name: change
props.description: The change since the last period, as written: "18%", "1,204". Shown with its direction in words and an icon, never colour alone.

props.name: good
props.description: Which direction is good news: `up` (default; sales), `down` (errors, load time) or `none` (neither: no colour).

props.name: period
props.description: The period the change is measured over: "since last month".

props.name: trend
props.description: Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a small line under the figure. It only illustrates: the change says it in words.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence under the figure that explains it.

props.name: size
props.description: `m` (default) for a row of figures; `l` for the one figure a view leads with.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the statistic's shape in shimmer while its figure loads.
